scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @pronoia/core && npm run build -w @pronoia/cli
scripts.pretest:coverage: npm run build -w @pronoia/core && npm run build -w @pronoia/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pronoia/core && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @pronoia/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pronoia/core && npm run build -w @pronoia/cli && npm run build -w @pronoia/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @pronoia/core && npm run start -w @pronoia/desktop
scripts.make: npm run build -w @pronoia/core && npm run make -w @pronoia/desktop
